This topic is part of the CCEA GCSE Biology specification.

Breathing & Respiration appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

The CCEA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Breathing & Respiration.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
